annotations.title: Delete a local rank grid config

description: Deletes a geo-grid rank-tracking config, INCLUDING its whole run and point history. Confirm with the user before calling.

configId.description: Config ID, from the matching get_* tool called without configId.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: delete_local_rank_grid_config
